name: Tempt with Vengeance
oracle_text: Tempting offer — Create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. Each opponent may create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. For each opponent who does, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste.

needs.what: a 1/1 red Elemental creature token with haste
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has elemental_1_1_ur (1/1 blue-red Elemental, no haste) and goblin_1_1_r / warrior_1_1_r (wrong subtype, no haste); none is a 1/1 red Elemental with haste. The tempting-offer structure itself looks expressible with for_each_player over opponents, a may with player set to that opponent creating the tokens under their control, and a count of acceptances driving the caster's extra create_token, so the token is the only blocker
